title: The Objective of the Spiritual Life

lines: “Mendicants, a noble disciple who has four things is a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.
It’s when a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the Buddha …
And they have the ethical conduct loved by the noble ones … leading to immersion.
A noble disciple who has these four things is a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.”
That is what the Buddha said.
Then the Holy One, the Teacher, went on to say:
confidence, and vision of the truth,
the objective of the spiritual life.”
